name: Popover
description: The `p-popover` component can be used to display some additional content on top of another in conjunction with the info
code:
<p-popover :theme="this.$store.getters.storefrontTheme" description="Hello World"></p-popover>
<p-icon :theme="this.$store.getters.storefrontTheme" name="information" aria="{ 'aria-label': 'Information icon' }"></p-icon>
<p-icon :theme="this.$store.getters.storefrontTheme" name="information" aria="{ 'aria-label': 'Information icon' }"></p-icon>
<p-text>
  Some content <p-popover>Some content</p-popover>
<p-popover description="Some content"></p-popover>
<p-popover description="Some content"></p-popover>
<p-popover direction="Some content">Some content</p-popover>
<p-text>
  Some content <p-popover aria="{ 'aria-label': 'Some more descriptive label' }">Some content</p-popover>

description.description: Descriptive text to show additional information when popover is open

direction.description: Preferred direction in which popover should open, given there is enough space in viewport. Otherwise, it will be opened in the direction with most available space.

theme.description: Adapts the popover color depending on the theme.

slotsMeta.description: Default slot for the popover content.
